In this video, we discuss about Mayawati's Bahujan Samaj Party which has emerged as an underdog in Kaimur's Ramgarh assembly constituency. We talk about how Satish Kumar Singh Yadav of BSP managed to win the lone seat for his party by just 30 seats.
We also discuss what it means for Bihar's politics and what are the conditions of Bihar's assembly constituency.
Khabargaon is a modern-day digital platform that helps you travel through current affairs, explainers, ground reports, interviews and unique video shows. Stay tuned for more and more!
